scope: Restricted expiring policy authority and native Perps request creation in isolated LiteSVM with deployed program bytes, captured protocol accounts and clock, and generated local wallets with virtual funds.

smartAccount.note: The fresh binary's effective ELF matches the official fixture; extra allocated trailing zero padding changes the full-file hash. The tested narrow policy ABI is observed directly against deployed bytes; the complete SDK/IDL is not qualified.

nativePerps.note: A default local clock caused InvalidAccountData for both direct and PDA controls. Loading the captured Clock sysvar resolved it; the original failing receipts are retained. No transaction was broadcast.

passedLocalChecks: Only the generated customer owner can change settings; a service delegate has no settings authority.
A finite-expiry ProgramInteractionPolicy executes an allowed System CPI and rejects wrong program, account, amount, expired authority and owner revocation.
Native Perps SOL/USDC short request creation succeeds with a direct generated signer and through the restricted policy-vault PDA.
Native Perps ETH long request creation succeeds with a direct generated signer and through the restricted policy-vault PDA.
The native Perps policy rejects increased notional, increased collateral, changed side, changed instruction discriminator and substituted custody before moving vault funds.

After policy expiry, the customer sole settings signer closes the unfilled native request through its vault using ClosePositionRequest3; request accounts are deleted and all virtual collateral returns to the original vault funding account. This is unfilled-request recovery, not a filled leveraged position close.
remainingActivationGates: Persist and verify the exact customer-owned policy vault, sole settings owner, restricted delegate, expiry, revocation and allowed assets/accounts/data in a production connection flow.
Pin and recheck deployed binary hashes; refuse upgrades until the used ABI and constraints are requalified.
Enforce a non-bypassable cumulative funding/spend limit for delegated automation, beyond a per-instruction notional cap.
Capture fresh pool/custody/oracle inputs, prove conservative economics and exercise the asynchronous keeper fill plus cancel/decrease/close lifecycle and uncertain-outcome reconciliation.
Verify native BTC support using its own captured custody, mint and oracle state; SOL/ETH simulation cannot certify it.
Implement the private production Jupiter signer/adapter and owner-bound automated bot activation; obtain explicit coordination before any real funding or financial acceptance test.
excluded: Live funding, network submission or keeper fill proof
